title: Mask Adoption Dynamics in a Population
description: Simulate how individuals adopt mask-wearing over time under social influence, information campaigns, supply constraints, and policy enforcement.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Neighbors in the social network influence each other's probability of wearing masks via conformity and observed behavior.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_at_location
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask policies; non-compliant persons may be warned or fined, affecting future compliance.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: Information sources broadcast messages that shift beliefs about mask efficacy and perceived risk.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Persons purchase masks from the market, constrained by availability and price.

interactions.name: risk_feedback
interactions.description: Reported case rates update persons' risk perception, altering adoption decisions.

interactions.name: mobility_and_contact
interactions.description: Persons move through locations (home, work, public spaces), where masking decisions are context-dependent.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each timestep.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate achieved during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days required for adoption to reach 50% for the first time.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_days_above_threshold
metrics.description: Total days adoption remains at or above a specified threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: adoption_by_location_type
metrics.description: Mask-wearing rates within each location type (home, work, public, etc.).

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_gini
metrics.description: Gini coefficient of adoption across demographic or income groups.

metrics.name: policy_impact_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to policy activation (e.g., difference-in-differences).

metrics.name: fine_incidents_per_1000_entries
metrics.description: Number of enforcement incidents normalized by location entries.

metrics.name: mask_purchases_per_capita
metrics.description: Average number of masks purchased per person over time.

metrics.name: exposure_weighted_adoption
metrics.description: Adoption rate weighted by contact intensity or location risk levels.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_of_adoption
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate 7-day moving average changes by less than 0.5 percentage points for 21 consecutive days.

validation_criteria.name: calibration_fit_rmse
validation_criteria.description: If empirical adoption data are provided, RMSE between simulated and observed adoption is below a predefined threshold (e.g., RMSE < 0.07).

validation_criteria.name: feasibility_constraints
validation_criteria.description: No negative inventories, adoption rates remain within [0,1], and probabilities remain valid at all steps.

validation_criteria.name: policy_monotonicity_sanity_check
validation_criteria.description: Stronger enforcement (higher fine or inspection probability) does not decrease adoption in sensitivity experiments holding other factors constant.

validation_criteria.name: stochastic_reproducibility
validation_criteria.description: Across multiple seeds (e.g., 20 runs), mean adoption trajectories fall within a narrow band (e.g., +/- 5% absolute) after the system stabilizes.
